_comment: Generated by Phase B audit (sub-issue #2127). See audits/2026-06-10-mockup-design-intent-audit.json for source.

acceptance._state_mapping_note: default: Frame01_Paused (save & exit, session paused, resume-card) + Frame02_Victory (campaign complete, highlights timeline). Frame03_Defeat (party wipe) + Frame04_Cancelled (abandon confirmation) are NARRATIVE OUTCOMES, not the canonical 'error' state (reserved for technical failures) — they remain story variants (SessionEndMockOutcome union paused|victory|defeat|cancelled) without a canonical state. De-mapped from 'error' per #2929.
